desc: Lantern spirit: pale paper-lantern body with three gold star flame tails. Face: warm closed crescent happy eyes (arcs) and a small round mouth, no pupils. Abstract spirit creature, no animal parts. Cute and cool chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Lavender, white, violet, gold palette. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
